Yes, this matches what I expect. Each bookmark having its own delete control, the card disappearing from the list, the count going down, and getting a "Bookmark deleted" confirmation all feel right.

And the caution level is good too — asking me to confirm before it's permanently gone is exactly what I'd want, so I don't accidentally lose a link I meant to keep. This works for me.
